title: DOE intelligence director never briefed on nuclear-site UAP incursions

tellings.quote:
Well, I can I can say completely openly
and transparently when I was in DOE and
I was director of intelligence,
I never was briefed on any of that.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer who was director of intelligence at the Department of Energy, the US agency in charge of nuclear weapons, says that in that job, around 2005 to 2008, he was never briefed on unidentified objects showing up at nuclear sites. He says it openly, from his own time in the post. If such incursions happened, it would mean they were kept even from the man running the department's intelligence.
